standard_prerequisites.name: Regular split
standard_prerequisites.use: Splits the two-step complex, isolating O_Delta.

core_obligations: Resolve O_Delta by box products of finite locally frees of length 2d.
The resolution complex has cohomology only in degrees 0 and -2d; regularity splits it, making O_Delta a direct summand.
The split object lies in the hull of the direct sum of the box terms, which collapses to a single box product.
proof_roadmap: Resolve, split by regularity, and collapse the hull; the closing parenthetical cites the containment lemmas.
difficulty_reason: Koszul-type resolution of the diagonal with a regularity split; fully displayed.
